description:
In this video I'm going to tell you about Aacidental Case में Insurance Claim पास कराने के लिए कौन सा Driving Licence चाहिए ?? Explained by @TechnicalAlokji via @YouTube in hindi language, However, it is one of the most important documents required to file a claim in case of an unfortunate accident. You cannot produce someone else's driving licence. Insurance companies will approve the claim only if the DL belongs to the person who was driving the insured car at the time of the accident. #rto #dl #technicalalokji #insurance #claim #india #like #subscribe #share #youtube #youtuber #ytshorts 
• Documents Required for Claim Process :-
1) Filled claim form along with your signature.
2) Tax receipts.
3) Copy of your insurance policy.
4) Copy of your car registration certificate (RC)
5) Driving license of the driver.
6) Copy of the FIR.
7) An estimated bill of the car's repair cost.
8) Original repair bills and payment receipts.
